_about: Tool-selection cases for evals/run_eval.py. Each prompt is phrased the way a developer would actually put it, never using the tool's own name, so the model has to choose from the descriptions alone. The pairs that can be confused are covered deliberately: comment vs field update, transition vs update, recent discussion vs history, listing an attachment vs fetching it.

scenarios.prompt: Which open bugs in the PLATFORM project are assigned to me right now?
I'm picking up ABC-123. What is it about and what state is it in?
Catch me up on the last few things people said on ABC-123.
We deployed on 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. What has been said on ABC-123 since then?
I need every single comment on ABC-123, all of them, not just a page.
Who moved ABC-123 out of code review, and when did the priority change?
Does ABC-123 have any files attached, and how big are they?
Open attachment 80001 so I can read the stack trace inside it.
Let the reporter of ABC-123 know I found the cause: a race in the retry loop.
The fix for ABC-123 is at https://example.invalid/pr/7 - put that on the ticket so the reviewer can find it.
I've started on ABC-123, move it along.
ABC-123 is done and deployed to staging. Close it out and say so on the ticket.
The title of ABC-123 has a typo: it should read 'Retry loop drops the last page'.
Tag ABC-123 as needing a follow-up, then leave the rest of it alone.
ABC-123 has to be finished by the end of the year. Record that.
